signin.title: Sign in
signin.description: Continue securely to your institution account.
signin.unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable. Please try again later.

error.title: Sign-in could not be completed
error.description: Your session could not be verified. Please try signing in again.
error.busy: There are too many sign-in requests. Please wait before trying again.

shell.signout_scope: Other signed-in institution tabs may also require sign-in.

session.unavailable: Your account could not be checked. You can check again or sign in again.
session.extended: Your session end time has been updated.
session.unchanged: The end time did not change. Sign in again before it expires.
session.maximum: This session will end at its maximum lifetime. Sign in again to continue.
session.failed: Your session could not be extended. Please sign in again.
session.expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
session.javascript_required: Session extension and unsaved-edit warnings require JavaScript. Forms still work. Save your changes before leaving; you can also sign out or sign in again.
session.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Submit the edited form before leaving, or leave to discard those edits.

entry.title: Choose your account access
entry.confirm: Confirm this account before choosing where to continue.
entry.missing: Your sign-in is verified. Create your LearnStack account to continue.
entry.empty: No institution access is available for this account. You can check again or sign out.
entry.unavailable: Account access could not be checked. You can try again.
entry.no_session: Sign in to choose an institution.
entry.reauthenticate: Your account label is unavailable. Sign out and sign in again to confirm your account.
entry.account_change_title: Another account is already signed in
entry.account_change: This institution already has a session for another account. Sign out of that session before signing in again.
entry.failure_reauthenticate: This sign-in can no longer be used. Sign in again to continue.
entry.failure_creation_disabled: Creating a LearnStack account is not available right now. You can check your account access again.
entry.failure_denied: This account access is not available. Check the available institutions before continuing.
entry.failure_busy: Too many account access requests. Wait before checking again.
entry.failure_unavailable: The result could not be confirmed. Check your account access again before deciding whether to repeat the action.
entry.retry_after: Seconds to wait before checking again
entry.scope_empty: No other account access is available.

mutation.title: Change not confirmed
mutation.denied: This change is not available in your current account access.
mutation.stale: This item changed. Read it again before preparing a new change.
mutation.in_progress: This request is still in progress. You may check the item or deliberately retry the same request.
mutation.key_reuse: This form was already used for a different change. Check the item and prepare a new change.
mutation.unavailable: The result could not be confirmed. Check the item before deciding whether to retry this same request.
mutation.edits_copy: Copy these values before checking the item. Review the current item and prepare a new change.
mutation.role_labels_unavailable: The names of the submitted roles are unavailable. Check the current item before preparing a new selection.
